landing.pageTitle: Happy Animals NFT Project | Collect NFTs & Save Wildlife
landing.metaDescription: Happy Animals is an NFT project that combines collectible animal-themed NFTs with wildlife conservation efforts. Participate in lotteries, support conservation, and own unique digital assets.
landing.ogDescription: Join the Happy Animals NFT project, collect unique animal-themed NFTs, participate in lotteries, and contribute to wildlife conservation.
landing.heroBody: Join the Happy Animals NFT project. Collect rare animal-themed NFTs and contribute to conservation efforts.
landing.aboutBody1: Happy Animals is a unique NFT project dedicated to wildlife conservation. By collecting our beautifully crafted animal-themed NFTs, you become eligible to participate in our exciting lotteries and support foundations working to protect endangered species.
landing.aboutBody2: Our goal is to create a positive impact through art, crypto, and the power of community engagement.
landing.collectionsBody: Explore our diverse range of NFT collections dedicated to endangered and other unique animal species. Each NFT represents not only a digital collectible but also our commitment to wildlife conservation.
landing.lotteryBody1: Every two weeks, Happy Animals NFT holders participate in an exclusive lottery. If your NFT's collection is selected as the winner, you will share the pot with other collection holders. Additionally, 5% of the pot is donated to wildlife conservation foundations related to the winning animal.
landing.lotteryBody2: Not only do you stand a chance to win, but your participation directly supports conservation efforts.
landing.conservationBody1: We believe in making a real difference. That’s why 5% of every lottery pot goes directly to wildlife foundations working tirelessly to protect endangered species. Your involvement helps us save habitats and support species in need.
landing.conservationBody2: We are committed to transparency and will regularly update the community on the impact of your contributions. Together, we can make a lasting difference in the lives of these incredible animals.
landing.joinBody: Be a part of our journey to protect wildlife. Follow us, explore our collections, and make a difference by contributing to conservation efforts through our NFT community.
landing.comingSoonBody: Stay tuned for updates on our token launch!

token.pageTitle: Happy Animals Token | Supporting Wildlife Conservation
token.metaDescription: Learn about the Happy Animals Token, its utility, distribution, and how it contributes to wildlife conservation efforts.
token.ogDescription: Discover how the Happy Animals Token empowers conservation and benefits NFT holders.
token.heroBody: The Happy Animals Token is at the core of our mission to integrate digital assets with real-world conservation efforts. Holders of our token can access exclusive benefits, participate in community decisions, and contribute directly to wildlife protection.
token.utilityBody: The Happy Animals Token drives our ecosystem, allowing holders to support conservation, access exclusive perks, and participate in community initiatives.
token.conservationSupportBody: A portion of proceeds directly funds wildlife protection.
token.communityEngagementBody: Vote on upcoming projects and initiatives.
token.exclusivePerksBody: Access rare NFT drops and events.

token.airdropBody: We're rewarding early supporters with an airdrop to show appreciation and involve them in our mission from the start.
token.automaticAirdropBody: SMILES Tokens will be automatically distributed to wallets holding eligible NFTs.
token.simpleParticipationBody1: No action required from your side.
token.simpleParticipationBody2: Just hold your NFTs and receive SMILES Tokens.
